content.text: How to enroll Open Subscription Applications

items.text: 1. Go to https://myncid.nc.gov/
2. Login by entering your username and password.
3. Go to the “Group” tab and click on the “ADD GROUP” button.

content.description: Screenshot of an ADD GROUP button highlighted with a yellow box

items.text: 4. Select the group(s) you want to be part of and click on the “Save” button.

content.description: Screenshot of a SAVE button highlighted with a yellow box

items.text: 1. Go to https://myncid.nc.gov/
2. Login by entering your username and password.
3. Click on the ⋮ in the upper right corner and click on “Delete my account”.

content.description: Screenshot of a DELETE MY ACCOUNT option with a trash can icon, highlighted with a yellow box

items.text: 4. Type “delete” to confirm and click on the “Delete” button.
